about: Senior Software Engineer and Tech Lead with 6+ years of experience across Oracle, Google, and Amazon, leading 10+ engineers owning 3 products and having built 7+ microservices from 0 to 1. Senior Bar Raiser / Key Interviewer at Oracle with expertise in cloud-native healthcare, search, and finance systems, distributed architectures, machine learning, and generative AI.

experience.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff (SDE-3) at Oracle
details: Working in Healthcare domain in XR team responsible for Clinical Reporting and output management.

Built 7+ Java Micronaut microservices from 0 to 1, transforming medical-record output into a modular Gen2 reporting platform; proposed modern AI capabilities, including an advanced AI-powered template builder, shaped the roadmap, and aligned product managers and partner teams.
Migrated Cerner enterprise applications to a modern architecture.

Led a project involving 3 engineers to deliver Gen1 Report Ingress and 6 APIs in 1 quarter + 1 month versus 2 quarters planned; enabled WebSphere-to-EJS migration with better performance, stability, scalability, and lower third-party cost.

Took ownership of highly ambiguous technical and product scopes, turning open questions into clear architecture and execution plans for initiatives including the SI DRZ region build and EHRC modernization program.

Built the India Clinical Reporting team from scratch and grew the leadership scope to 10+ engineers across 3+ products; conducted 100+ interviews, contributed to 25+ hires as a Senior Key Interviewer (Bar Raiser), and mentored and judged 12 OraHacks AI teams.

experience.title: Software Engineer-2 at Google
details: Worked in Search India Education Team, developing features for exam OSRPs.
Built the Exam Quiz feature and migrated architecture.

Launched localized Exam OSRPs in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu with exam dates, fees and waivers, tabbed result layouts, and the Periodic Table; localization reached 0.03% of Search queries and 0.0019% of educational queries, improving accessibility.
Collaborated across Search teams to resolve production issues, align requirements, and prioritize high-impact improvements.

Contributed to Google Bard’s early model-improvement journey by training and evaluating LLM responses, helping improve output quality as the technology evolved from unreliable early behavior toward practical usefulness.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer-1 at Amazon
details: Built duplicate- and anomaly-detection capabilities for invoice creation and update workflows handling 1 lakh+ daily requests across Amazon’s retail, non-retail, and corporate finance systems.
Implemented ML-based rules discovering over 100M USD anomalies.
Built APIs and operational dashboards for monitoring and alerting, and used AWS CDK to provision infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines across multiple services.

experience.title: Problem Curator Intern at HackerEarth
details: Curated and tested algorithmic problems for hiring and internal contests at Google, Facebook, Nokia, PayPal, Salesforce, and Infosys, including HackWithInfy with 167,000+ participants.
Helped increase Nokia’s post-contest Net Promoter Score from 7 to 8 by strengthening problem quality, accelerating issue resolution, and promptly addressing participant queries.
Presented workshop on Advanced Data Structures and Algorithms.
